name: Sharna, the Blade of Raise Moon
effectText: When you draw this card: You can reveal it; Special Summon this card. If you do: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; place it on the bottom of the Deck. You can discard this card; draw 1 card. You cannot add cards from the Main Deck to your hand the turn you activate this effect, except by drawing them. You can only use this effect of "Sharna, the Blade of Raise Moon" once per turn.
